response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_len) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) t

assumptions.assumption: Ratings are grouped by the film.rating column. NULL lengths and NULL ratios are ignored by AVG. The ratio is computed per film as rental_rate / replacement_cost and then averaged within each rating. The final step averages the per-rating averages with equal weight, not weighted by film count.
